attributes.board_name: Arizona State Board of Dental Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Recognized Continuing Dental Education (seminars, lectures, interactive audio-video programs, advanced training); self-study with exam, Board service, peer review, teaching, publications and charitable clinic service limited to 15 hours
rules.new_licensee_rule: Complete the prescribed hours by the end of the first full renewal period; no CE affidavit if initially licensed within the year before expiration.
rules.alternatives: Extension on written request (military service, missionary activity, foreign residence or other extenuating circumstances).
rules.audit_note: Affidavit with the renewal listing hours by category; Board audits yearly; documentation due within 35 days of notice.

topics.who: Infectious diseases or infectious disease control
CPR/ACLS/PALS hours; current card also required

rules.notes: Triennial license; renew by the last day of the birth month every third year (fee up to $325). 45 h: at least 25 clinical/hygiene areas, max 11 practice management, at least 3 h in chemical dependency, tobacco cessation, ethics, risk management or AZ jurisprudence (mixed, no single code), 3 h CPR/ACLS/PALS (current card required). 12 h if providing botulinum toxin/dermal fillers.
